court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
trial_court: Additional Principal Judge/A.D.J. Family Court, Lucknow - Misc. Case No. 382C/2010
case_name: Smt. Hema Srivastava vs Arvind Kumar Srivastava And Ors.

parties.respondent_defendant: Arvind Kumar Srivastava And Ors. (husband and others)

facts_of_case: Marriage between the parties was solemnized in 2010. The relationship became strained, and the petitioner left her matrimonial home. The respondent filed a petition under Section 9 of Hindu Marriage Act 1955 for restitution of conjugal rights. The petitioner filed an application under Section 24 of the Act for maintenance.

legal_principles.principle: The quantum of maintenance depends upon the position and status of the parties, including their financial positions.
legal_principles.held: No rigid formula about percentage of income can be fixed for giving maintenance. The quantum depends upon the status and income of the parties.
cited_cases: Ekradeshwari Vs. Homeshwar, AIR 1929 Privy Council 128
Kulbhushan Vs. Raj Kumari, AIR 1971 Supreme Court 234

legal_principles.principle: A wife is entitled to accommodation in the same house or a separate building if the husband is living in his own house.
legal_principles.held: If the husband is living in his own house, the wife is also entitled to accommodation in the same house or in a separate building.
cited_cases: Dev Dutt Singh V. Rajani Gandhi, 1984 (1) DMC Delhi 212

outcome.final_order: The order dated 7.4.2014 passed by the learned Additional Principal Judge, Family Court, Lucknow was set aside and the matter was remanded back to the Additional Principal Judge, Family Court, Lucknow.

keywords: Latin Maxim: Nemo dat quod non habet
use_for_drafting: advising on restitution of conjugal rights
